newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bancomer says issues CDs in Euro markets.
newsitem.headline: Bancomer says issues CDs in Euro markets.

text.p: Mexican financial group Grupo Financiero Bancomer said on Thursday it issued 200 million pesos in certificates of deposit on European markets.
The 375-day paper was issued at the rate of the one-year Mexican Treasury bills (Cetes) plus 25 basis points, the company said in a statement.
"This issue allows Bancomer to diversify its sources of funding, improve its assets and liabilities profile, and fund projects at a fixed rate in pesos for a year," the company said.
The paper was led by Chase Manhattan Bank and conducted through Bancomer's London office.
